name: residency
description: Residents-only rooms. A tile carrying `flags.residents_only: "<building name>"` is walled off by a move gate unless the player holds a unit in that building (engine isResidentOf, read off the in-memory apartments cache). `flags.residents_only_deny` overrides the refusal line. Shipped for the Solenne Residences' private roof helipad; any amenity floor inherits it by carrying the flag. No verbs.
